newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore's TDB seeking to clarify oil stock data.
newsitem.headline: Singapore's TDB seeking to clarify oil stock data.

text.p: Singapore's Trade Development Board (TDB) said it was seeking to clarify the level of middle distillate stocks reported in its weekly data earlier on Thursday, officials said.
The TDB said middle distillate stocks rose to 1.9 billion barrels in the week ended June 4. It had reported stocks of 10.5 million barrels for the week ended May 28.
TDB officials told Reuters said they would seek to clarify the data, which relates to onshore storage.
Traders said Singapore's onshore storage capacity was 22 million barrels and that Singapore refiners produced about 11.9 million barrels of middle distillates on average each month.
TDB also reported on Wednesday that residue stocks totalled 10.3 million barrels, down 465,000 barrels on the week and that light distillate stocks rose 94,000 barrels to 6.756 million barrels.
